reference_reaction_scope: NH/OH reference produces neutral HCl. The completed DBU/DIPEA pilot separately models base consumption and separated ions or a chloride contact pair in MeCN at 298.15 K.
other_candidates_status: Attachment feasibility unassessed; a nonpositive reference deltaG does not confer automatic synthesis eligibility.
